walkthroughs.body_html: Going into denser medium: slower, bends towards normal.

Above critical angle: all light reflected.

Optical fibres carry data using TIR.

mcqs.q: If one EM wave has a higher frequency than another, what is true about its wavelength?
options: It is unchanged — only the speed differs.
Yes — UV is the colour purple.
It is shorter — wavelength and frequency are inversely related (c = f x lambda).
It is also longer, because both increase together.

mcqs.q: How do you see a non-luminous object like a book?
options: Your eyes send out beams of vision that hit the book and let you see it.
Yes — UV is the colour purple.
The book emits a special invisible signal that your brain detects directly.
Light from a source reflects off the book and enters your eyes.

mcqs.q: Is ultraviolet light visible to humans?
options: Yes — UV is visible because it's right next to violet.
No — even though it sits next to violet on the spectrum, its frequency is above the range our eyes detect.
The book emits a special invisible signal that your brain detects directly.
Yes — UV is the colour purple.
